changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: The original fixed-K5 DSpark recipe remains unchanged. This Candidate selects upstream's supported MODE=mtp0 target-only path, the proven padded-FP8 sparse-MLA cache, 262,144-token model limit, four scheduling slots, 8,192-token scheduler batch, CUDA graph sizes 1/2/4, and 0.95 memory utilization.
changes.summary: Added a separate target-only SparkInfer canary that fits the current lower one-Spark memory baseline.

changes.details: At the pinned source revision, target-only acceptance records 92.13 GiB loaded weights, 12.49 GiB KV, semantic generation, and strict JSON-schema output. The clean fixed-K5 DSpark record reports 95.39 GiB after target plus draft load. Omitting that measured 3.26 GiB draft load supports the conservative two-GB startup reduction used by the 126 GB admission envelope.
changes.summary: Bound the low-memory claim to upstream's immutable physical target-only and DSpark records.

changes.details: The exact published image and 126 GB declaration remain Candidate until a Vonk-managed Spark canary records import, boot, memory headroom, endpoint health, bounded generation, and structured output.
